The tail lacks the necessary aerodynamic definition (fins/pointed tip). It appears to melt slightly into the background or simply ends abruptly without proper structural termination.
The metal trusses in the background show slight inconsistencies in parallel lines and depth, suggesting minor geometric warping common in AI backgrounds.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the tail section. Real airships have distinct vertical and horizontal stabilizers. If the image shows a smooth, fin-less tail, it is a significant structural hallucination. Also, scrutinize the 'METRO' text; AI often fails to render clean typography on curved surfaces.
